description: Minimum track record length, in observations and years, for an observed Sharpe to beat a benchmark at a confidence level, and with observations, the record's probabilistic Sharpe so far. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

non_excess_kurtosis.description: Kurtosis, not excess kurtosis; 3 if Normal.

observations.description: Record length so far, to get its probabilistic Sharpe.

periods_per_year.description: Observations per year: 252 daily, 365 daily crypto, 52 weekly, 12 monthly.

skew.description: Skewness of the returns; below -0.5 the reading warns that the counts are too generous.

name: validate_track_record
title: Minimum track record length
